evidence.name: Screen field: Space around the title
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Space around the title" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Space around the title
sections.description: Sets the empty space, in pixels, on each side of the step title: top, right, bottom, left. The default is usually 0; add bottom padding to separate the title from the subtitle below, or side padding to keep long titles off the screen edges. A clear, uncrowded title is the first thing visitors read, so the small spacing tweak helps them grasp the offer fast and stay in the funnel.
